name: satelit-js
lines: The official client for Node, Deno, Bun and Workers.
105 typed methods, one per route. Zero dependencies.

name: satelit-python
lines: Sync and async clients on the standard library alone.
Typed answers, paging and NDJSON export built in.

name: satelit-go
lines: A Go module plus the satelit command line tool.
Context aware, typed structs, a Prometheus exporter.

name: satelit-php
lines: Runs on old shared hosting and on PHP 8.4 alike.
Composer or one require. File cache included.

name: satelit-wordpress
lines: Ten blocks: BNM rates, converter, fuel, prices,
news and cinemas. Market prices in WooCommerce.

name: satelit-opencart
lines: BNM rates written into your store's currencies.
The market price shown on every product page.

name: satelit-prestashop
lines: BNM rates for your currencies, with a cron URL.
Prices in other Moldovan shops beside your own.

name: satelit-joomla
lines: A module with six layouts and tags inside articles.
Rates, fuel, news, cinemas, laws and the joke of the day.

name: satelit-drupal
lines: Five blocks with Twig templates and cache tags.
The key stays in State, never in exported config.

name: satelit-cinema
lines: A complete cinema website for Moldova, ready to deploy.
Sessions by city, film pages, search. Three languages.
tested: Node 18+, no dependencies, Docker file included

name: satelit-widgets
lines: Six web components for Tilda, Wix or plain HTML.
The key sits in a proxy: Node, Cloudflare or PHP.

name: satelit-examples
lines: Twelve working projects: a Telegram bot, Sheets,
price alerts, Grafana, court calendars, movie night.
tested: Each one run against the live API
